caption: The drawing depicts a detailed rendering of a single object that appears to be a metal door knocker or ornamental plate. The object is centered on a plain, light beige background. It is composed of a roughly rectangular backplate with softened and uneven edges. The backplate features a pattern of repeated short, engraved lines and a small circular knob towards the bottom, along with a curled flourish at its lowest edge. Attached to the upper section is a large, thick ring set into a circular fixture. In the center of the ring fixture is a raised floral rosette with symmetrical petals. The ring itself is textured with a lined pattern. The overall color of the drawing is monochromatic, using shades of gray and black to create depth, detail, and shadow on the object. The artist's signature, "LIPKIN," is located in small letters on the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Door Knocker
